result:
Personal API tokens are in place. Typecheck, `bun test` (10 tests, including new ones), and `bunx guren gate` all pass.

Tokens use the framework's `createApiToken`, which stores only a SHA-256 hash of the secret in the new `api_tokens` table. A bearer middleware authenticates `/api/posts` (GET and POST), and a per-token limiter allows 60 requests a minute and answers 429 with `Retry-After` on the 61st. The profile page has a token section: create (the token is shown once), list by name, and revoke. The changes are spread across `db/schema.ts` and its new migration, `app/Http/Middleware/ApiTokenAuth.ts`, the two new controllers, `routes/api.ts`, `routes/auth.ts`, `routes/web.ts`, `ProfileController.ts`, `resources/js/pages/profile/Edit.tsx`, and `tests/ApiTokens.test.ts`. Nothing is committed. The profile UI was not exercised in a browser, and the dev database still needs `bun run db:migrate` before the table exists there.
